title: Placing the Control Plane: Cloud-Native Federated Learning Across Batch-Scheduled HPC
abstract: arXiv:2611.30381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The United Kingdom's AI Research Resource (AIRR) opens national supercomputers to a community familiar with always-reachable cloud services. With batch-scheduled HPC, a user requests a time-bounded allocation that is then reclaimed. Federated Learning (FL) exposes this tension, pairing a long-lived control plane with short-lived training. We characterize the resulting placement asymmetry: the coordination server sees only model updates and control metadata, so it can sit on neutral infrastructure, whereas the client control process is bound to the participating site's data and must remain within its trust boundary. The outbound-only connection this implies is also how edge clients connect, though the batch-scheduler mismatch is specific to HPC. translated_title: 控制平面放置：跨批调度HPC的云原生联邦学习
translated_abstract: 英国的AI研究资源（AIRR）向一个熟悉始终可连接的云服务的社区开放了国家超级计算机。在使用批调度HPC时，用户请求一个有时间限制的分配，随后该分配被收回。联邦学习（FL）揭示了这种矛盾，将长生命周期的控制平面与短生命周期的训练结合在一起。我们由此刻画了相应的放置不对称性：协调服务器仅看到模型更新和控制元数据，因此可以位于中立基础设施上，而客户端控制进程则绑定于参与站点的数据，必须留在其信任边界之内。这种仅出站连接的方式也是边缘客户端的连接方式，尽管批调度器的不匹配是HPC特有的。我们演示了一个跨越三个独立管理系统（Isambard-AI、Isambard 3和Zenith）的跨silo联邦，使用未经修改的生产级FL框架（FLARE封装的Flower），并……（原文摘要不完整，翻译至截断处）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向批调度HPC环境的联邦学习控制平面放置方案，使协调服务器部署在中立基础设施上、客户端控制进程保留在站点信任边界内，并利用未修改的生产级框架实现了跨三个独立管理系统的跨silo联邦学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a control-plane placement approach for federated learning across batch-scheduled HPC systems, placing the coordination server on neutral infrastructure while keeping client control processes within each site's trust boundary, and demonstrating a cross-silo federation spanning three independently administered systems using unmodified production FL frameworks.
